issues.message: Not yet placed by a builder GameTest: stone, stonecutter, andesite, stone_brick_slab.
The roof does not reach past the walls on any two opposite sides: give it one block of overhang.

notes.roof: the automatic roof warning is a miss: the hut roof overhangs front and back; the crane beam confuses the check
notes.materials: the crane boom is a pale birch beam that stands out against the dark hut; spruce or dark oak would sit better, not a must

visual.summary: Adds the timber crane with chain and lantern and more stacked blocks. Now it reads as a quarry.
problems: Reachability (flood fill from the ground outside): every floor and room is reached; only roof slopes and the tops of furniture are not, which is right

notes.detail: Crane, rock benches, stonecutter, tool rack and rubble are the new job, but the pit itself is still mostly flat cobble/gravel with low walls.
notes.roof: Automatic 'no overhang' warning is a false alarm: the shed roof overhangs on all sides in the renders.
notes.levels: The log crane with spruce jib, chain and hanging stone plus the walled pit benches make it clearly different from L1.

visual.summary: Working quarry: adds the small log crane with a spruce jib and hanging stone, the first rock benches and walls, a stonecutter, a tool rack and rubble.
problems: Pit floor is still large flat cobble/gravel areas: break them with a few more cut blocks, slabs, a mined face with andesite/gravel, or tools so it doesn't read bare.
Reachability: all work areas reached; unreached are roof slopes, the crane jib top (x4..9 y7 z10) and tops of rock benches, which is right.
